caption:
Momo loves a stretch and is very bendy, but the kneecap sometimes feels wobbly on the stairs.

The kneecap glides along a groove in the thigh bone, and the thigh and hip muscles help steer it. For bendy bodies, building strength often helps more than stretching further. Start with quad sets: press the knee down into a rolled towel, hold 5 seconds, 10 reps, twice a day, plus side-lying leg lifts, 10 each side.

If the kneecap has ever popped out, the knee keeps swelling, or it suddenly gives way, an assessment comes first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
